### A0 census results
- 第一轮 today object matrix 冻结如下：
  - `ActivationBucket = registered-but-proxied`
  - `PreMphfBase = registered-but-proxied`
  - `PreMphfBand = missing`
  - `Idx2Row = registered-but-proxied`
  - `RowIndex = shadow-only`
  - `RowDescriptor = registered-but-proxied`
  - `ValueRegion = registered-but-proxied`
  - `RetireTicket = registered-but-proxied`
  - `SyncBarrier = registered-but-proxied`
- 关键结论：
  - today `PE` 里几乎没有已经正式对象化的 shared object family
  - `rowdescriptor` 虽然是最活跃 seam，但本质仍是 proxy lifecycle，不是 formal object authority

## 2026-04-01 17:25 CST - PE runtime pod gate root-cause fix + closed-loop rerun

- What changed:
  - Added source-level observability for rowindex seam diagnostics in [sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent.cc).
    - New `[atlas-rowidx]` finish log prints rowindex lifecycle plus pod guard / owner / join / service counters.
  - Added a regression seam test in [sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/tests/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/tests/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.cc) that starts with pod gate disabled and requires a runtime config injection before `beginApplyWindow()` can promote rowidx touches into the pod/service plane.
  - Added a narrow runtime setter in [sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/services/synapse/weights/WeightMemorySubsystem.h](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/services/synapse/weights/WeightMemorySubsystem.h):
    - `setPeInternalPodRuntimeConfig(...)`
  - Exposed PE-effective pod config getters in [sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/MultiCorePE.h](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/MultiCorePE.h).
  - Wired parent-PE runtime injection into [sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent.cc) inside `refreshSharedWeightObjectPlaneBinding_()`.

- Root cause:
  - The earlier “PE config reaches `MultiCorePE` but runtime rowindex seam still dead” contradiction is now resolved.
  - `MultiCorePE::initializeProcessingUnits()` only injects synthesized `pe_internal_*` into `core_params` on the anonymous default-load path.
  - In the actual mesh/spec flow we are using explicit user-configured `core0/core1` slots, so those synthesized params do not override the Python-provided `pe.core` params.
  - After the scope cleanup, `components.pe.core` intentionally no longer carries `pe_internal_*`, so the core/WMS gate bits stayed false at runtime even though PE-level metadata/owner/service tables were instantiated.
  - Evidence from the new finish log before the fix:
    - `materialize/publicize > 0`
    - but `guard_disabled == guard_rowindex > 0`
    - and `frontier/owner/join/service == 0`
  - This proved the failing boundary was “WMS rowindex observe attempts are live, but the pod shadow gate is still disabled in the core-owned runtime object.”

- How to run / verify:
  - Seam test:
    ```bash
    cd "/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL"
    g++ -std=c++17 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections \
      -I. -I./api -I./services \
      -I"/home/xgy/remote/sst_install_mpi/include" \
      "./tests/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.cc" \
      "./services/synapse/weights/WeightMemorySubsystem.cc" \
      "./services/synapse/weights/SnnBcsrWeightManager.cc" \
      "./services/synapse/weights/WeightAccessor.cc" \
      "./services/synapse/gas/GasEdgeCollector.cc" \
      "./services/pe_fabric/PeSharedCoreFabric.cc" \
      "./services/memory/sram_sim/model/BankedSramModel.cc" \
      -Wl,--gc-sections \
      -o "/tmp/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.run" && \
      "/tmp/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.run"
    ```
  - Rebuild/install:
    ```bash
    cd "/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL"
    make -j4 libSnnDL.la && make install
    ```
  - Closed-loop experiment:
    ```bash
    bash "/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-03-31_atlas_service_rowindex_object_ab_v1/run_ab.sh"
    ```
  - Key outputs:
    - [mainexp/experiments/2026-03-31_atlas_service_rowindex_object_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_object_on/20260401-172046/mesh_run.log](/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-03-31_atlas_service_rowindex_object_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_object_on/20260401-172046/mesh_run.log)

    - [mainexp/experiments/2026-03-31_atlas_service_rowindex_object_ab_v1/snapshot/compare.tsv](/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-03-31_atlas_service_rowindex_object_ab_v1/snapshot/compare.tsv)

- Metrics / results:
  - The disabled-gate signature is gone:
    - `guard_disabled = 0`
    - `guard_rowindex = 0`
  - Runtime rowindex seam is now actually entering PE shared storage/object planes:
    - `atlas_storage.pod_metadata_observe_total = 571`
    - `atlas_storage.pod_metadata.rowindex.observe_total = 571`
    - `atlas_storage.pod_owner_owner_alloc_total = 256`

  - The rowindex producer side is unchanged and still healthy:

    - `atlas_shadow.rowindex.runtime_prefetch_rows_total = 142`
  - Performance-side cost remains similar to the pre-fix on-run:
    - `memory.memory_requests = 320`
    - `memhierarchy.memctrl.req_total = 886`
  - Important current limitation:
    - `atlas_service_join_live_total = 0`
    - `atlas_service_join_ready_total = 0`

    - join traffic is currently landing as `late_join`, not `live` or `ready`.

- Interpretation:
  - We have successfully moved from “rowindex shadow exists but never enters the PE internal object machine” to “rowindex metadata/owner/join now do enter the PE internal object machine.”
  - The next blocker is no longer gate propagation. It is now a timing / contract problem between:
    - rowindex metadata observe / owner allocation
    - rowindex prefetch completion / ready marking
    - consumer join timing within the single-window run
  - Concretely, the architecture is now in the right state to study `ready` semantics; we are no longer stuck outside the shared plane.

    - is rowindex prefetch completion not calling `notePeInternalPodServiceObjectReady_()` on the shared-owner path?
    - is the single-window experiment too short to expose `ready` before `EndScatter`?
  - Keep the next optimization stage focused on `ready/live` timing rather than more metadata formation work, because the metadata/owner plane is now verified alive.

## 2026-04-02 PE-internal rowindex service-object ready/release contract fix

- What changed:
  - Tightened the PE-local rowindex service-object lifetime so `EndScatter` no longer releases `OwnerActive` rowindex entries before they become `Ready`.
  - Added shared-table deferred-release closure so an owner-closed rowindex entry can still be released when a later completion marks it ready from any core.
  - Added two seam regressions covering:
    - owner `EndScatter` before ready must not force `late_join`
    - owner-closed entry must still release after a joiner-side late ready
  - Affected files:
    - [WeightMemorySubsystem.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/services/synapse/weights/WeightMemorySubsystem.cc)

    - [test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/tests/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam.cc)

  - Focused seam regression:
    - `/tmp/test_pe_internal_pod_shadow_wms_seam` exit code `0`
    - newly covered contracts:
      - `test_real_wms_rowidx_endscatter_before_ready_keeps_owner_active_until_late_completion`
      - `test_real_wms_rowidx_joiner_late_ready_releases_owner_closed_entry`
  - Build verification:
    - `make test-compile` passed
    - `make -j4 libSnnDL.la` passed
    - `make install` passed
  - Real run delta (`rowindex_object_on` vs `rowindex_object_off`):
    - `atlas_service_join_live_total = 162`
    - `atlas_service_late_join_total = 0`
    - `atlas_service_ready_transition_total = 9`
    - `atlas_service_released_total = 9`
    - `atlas_object_lifecycle.service_release_total = 9`
    - `atlas_object_lifecycle.ready_to_release_gap_total = 0`
    - `atlas_service_active_entries_total = 247`
  - Final rowindex finish log:
    - core0:
      - `join_live=162 ready=9 release=9 svc_late=0`
    - core1:
      - `owner_form=256 release=0`

- Interpretation:
  - The original regression was confirmed as a lifetime bug, not a join-logic bug:
    - owner core closed the rowindex object at per-core `EndScatter`
    - joiner then saw `released/not-ready` and fell into `late_join`
  - The first fix restored the useful region:
    - `late_join` dropped to `0`
    - `join_live` reappeared
    - `ready_transition` started firing again
  - The second fix closed the remaining lifecycle hole:
    - shared service entries can now carry a deferred-release intent in the shared table
    - later ready from another core can complete `ready -> release` without depending on owner-local timing

    - ready-after-close releases
    - release deferred due to owner-active
  - Re-run the same contract on multi-window cases to confirm active-entry residue does not accumulate across windows.
  - Use this corrected rowindex object-machine as the reference contract before moving to idx2 / pre-band / broader PE-internal object-plane designs.

    - `rowidx_close_attempt_not_active_total`: `0 -> 324`
    - `rowidx_close_attempt_not_owner_total`: `0 -> 306`
  - 关键解释：
    - 当前真正起作用的是 response-driven rowindex completion path，而不是 cached/apply-promote ready path。
    - `rowidx_cache_fills_total = 128`，但 `rowidx_cache_hits_total = 0`，说明实验性 rowindex cache 目前没有进入真实命中收益空间。
    - `ready_transition_apply_promote_cached_total = 0`，说明“更早 ready”没有靠 cached promote 生效。
    - `close_attempt_*` 总量很大，且 `already_pending / not_active / not_owner` 占比高，说明 close sweep 仍偏 broadcast 式，存在大量无效 close。
  - 命名语义注意：
    - `rowidx_ready_signal_prefetch_response_total` 在 `spec_off` 也会非零，因此它并不严格等价于“experimental prefetch response only”。
    - 当前更准确的解释是“rowindex response path ready-signal candidate”，后续需要重命名或拆分为普通 rowindex response 与 experimental-prefetch response 两路计数。

- Next steps / TODO:
  - 主方向从“继续堆 cache-hit 假设”转向“把 PE 内 service machine 看清楚”：
    - 继续深挖 response-driven ready 为何稀疏；
    - 解释为什么 `apply-promote cached ready` 没有进入收益空间；
    - 解释为什么 `cache_fills > 0` 但 `cache_hits = 0`。
  - 机制修正优先级：
    - 把 touched-row broadcast close 收紧成 owner/object-led close queue，减少 `already_pending / not_active / not_owner` 的无效 close 扫描；
    - 将 response-path ready 与 experimental-prefetch ready 彻底拆计，避免语义混淆；
    - 继续补齐 `PE internal core/object/service/local-storage machine` 的结构化统计，再决定是否做新的行为优化。
  - 保持实验隔离：
    - 继续使用 `mainexp/experiments/2026-03-31_atlas_service_rowindex_object_ab_v1`
    - 只在实验开关下推进，不改 baseline contract。

- What changed:

  - 在 [`sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent.cc`](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent.cc)、[`sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/ExperimentalNocPrefetchPeStats.h`](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/ExperimentalNocPrefetchPeStats.h)、[`sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/MultiCorePE.h`](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/MultiCorePE.h)、[`sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/MultiCorePE.cc`](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/components/MultiCorePE.cc)：

    - `rowindex_stress_on`: [20260403-114845](/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_atlas_rowindex_noninflight_stress_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_stress_on/20260403-114845)

- Metrics/results:
  - Original high-stress `on` run before repair:
    - run dir:
      - `/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_rowindex_detached_overlap_stress_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_detached_overlap_on/20260403-131522`
    - observed fatal in:
      - `/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_rowindex_detached_overlap_stress_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_detached_overlap_on/20260403-131522/mesh_run.log`
    - failure signature:
      - `GatherBufferIF fatal: openStep called while stage=2 (expected Idle)`
    - supporting evidence:
      - repeated step-gate fallback EndGather/EndApply warnings before fatal
  - Root-cause interpretation:
    - `stage=2` maps to `Apply`
    - `MultiCorePE::beginGlobalStep_()` opens the next step through `SnnPESubComponent::onGlobalStepStart()`
    - with fixed-cycle completion under heavy memory latency and many cores, the previous window can still be in `Apply` when the next `openStep()` arrives
  - Current execution status:
    - the Pascal-style `on` run has been launched at:
      - `/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_rowindex_detached_overlap_stress_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_detached_overlap_pascal_on/20260403-132759`
    - at log time, the run is still active and has not yet emitted final `mesh_stats.csv`

- Interpretation:
  - The first blocker to detached overlap exploration was not “no overlap exists”, but “the stress harness violated the step-gate completion contract”.
  - Moving from `fixed` to `drain` is the correct first repair because it preserves the exact step/window contract instead of weakening `GatherBufferIF`.
  - A second issue remains practical rather than semantic: very aggressive `500ns + fanout256` stress is expensive enough that it can become a poor first-turn overlap probe.
  - The new Pascal-style lane is intended to reach the same detached-demand observation point with a wider gather window and lower activation pressure, improving the odds of obtaining usable counters before system-level saturation dominates.

That made overlap a narrow latency race instead of a stable contract.
  - With the new carry knob enabled, Gather still collects the frontier, but detached rowidx issuance can be shifted to BeginApply and tagged with the active window id, which is the right semantic setup for deterministic overlap experiments.

## 2026-04-03 Rowidx Gather Phase-Skew Parallel Investigation

- What changed:
  - Parallel read-only investigation split into three threads:
    - `pending_rows` lifecycle / clear paths
    - Gather/Apply event ordering and per-core stage skew
    - experiment harness / validator noise
  - Local code adjustment:
    - [SnnWorkload.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/services/workload/snn/SnnWorkload.cc): gated `noteWindowTouch()` on `stage_ok`
    - [SnnPESubComponent_spike.cc](/home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL/control/SnnPESubComponent_spike.cc): gated direct spike-path `noteWindowTouch()` on local stage legality

- How to run / verify:
  - Rebuild:
    - `cd /home/xgy/remote/sst_workspace/sst-elements/src/sst/elements/SnnDL && make -W 'services/workload/snn/SnnWorkload.cc' 'services/workload/snn/SnnWorkload.lo' && make -W 'control/SnnPESubComponent_spike.cc' 'control/SnnPESubComponent_spike.lo' && make 'libSnnDL.la'`
  - Probe:
    - `cd /home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_rowindex_detached_overlap_stress_ab_v1 && ./run_case.sh rowindex_detached_overlap_probe_time_on`
  - Latest runs inspected:
    - `/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_rowindex_detached_overlap_stress_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_detached_overlap_probe_time_on/20260403-165312`
    - `/home/xgy/remote/mainexp/experiments/2026-04-03_rowindex_detached_overlap_stress_ab_v1/runs/rowindex_detached_overlap_probe_time_on/20260403-165500`

- Metrics / results:
  - Validator `code 1` is confirmed to be noise from `model.num_pes` vs `node_limit=1`; the run itself is valid.
  - Read-only investigation confirmed:
    - Direct `pending_rows.clear()` paths are concentrated in `beginGatherWindow()` reset and the `beginApplyWindow()` branch that only fires when `carry_to_apply_enable=0`.
    - Current probe does have `carry_to_apply_enable=1`, so the active issue is not that explicit Apply-side clear branch.
    - Stronger architectural suspicion is PE-level `BeginGather` triggering step activation before all target cores have locally executed `beginGatherWindow()`, allowing early touch then later per-core reset.
  - The stage-gated `noteWindowTouch()` patch did **not** change probe outcome:
    - `touch≈483-491/core`
    - `carry_pending=0`
    - `prefetch_rows=0`
    - `budget_ticks=0`
  - Interpretation:
    - The problem is likely not simply “window-external touches”.
    - More likely it is per-core Gather phase skew / local window initialization timing.

- Next steps / TODO:
  - Instrument exact ordering of per-core `beginGatherWindow()` versus first local `noteWindowTouch()` event.
  - Add one-shot logs or counters around local Gather-open to confirm whether touches arrive before a target core has reset/opened its own Gather window.
  - Do not spend more time tuning detached prefetch budget until the per-core Gather-open contract is proven.

    - `test_summarize_atlas_activation_trace.py`: `Ran 4 tests` -> `OK`

  - Sidecar now also reflects the corrected requested-config picture for the `on` run:

    - `config_requested.pe_internal_pod_enable = 1`
    - `config_requested.pe_internal_pod_metadata_enable = 1`
    - `config_requested.pe_internal_pod_owner_enable = 1`
  - Crucial cross-plane observation:
    - in `rowindex_object_on/20260403-115724`, the object machine is clearly active:
      - `pe_local_service_object = active`
      - `pod_owner_entry = active`
      - `pod_metadata_object = shadow-only`
      - `rowindex = shadow-only`
    - but the activation-census runtime plane still reports zero for all of:
      - `atlas_enable_state_local_storage_effective_total`
      - `atlas_enable_state_pe_internal_pod_effective_total`
      - `atlas_activation_gate_pe_internal_pod_requested`
      - `atlas_activation_gate_service_table_constructed`
      - `atlas_activation_gate_pod_metadata_plane_constructed`
      - `atlas_activation_gate_pod_owner_table_constructed`

- Interpretation:
  - The original bug was real: we were reading the wrong configuration layer and falsely reporting `build_off`.
  - After fixing that bug, a second and more architecture-relevant fact remains:
    - the PE object machine can already show real rowindex/pod/service activity
    - yet the current activation-census runtime plane does not expose corresponding `requested/effective/constructed` counters
  - This is now the main modeling gap:
    - not “does the object machine exist?”
    - but “which plane currently owns visibility over PE-local object progress?”
  - In other words, `object_kind_census` and `contract_mismatch` are now telling a coherent story:
    - build-time intent is present
    - object activity is present
    - runtime activation-census coverage for the PE-local object plane is still incomplete

  - Treat the next modeling stage as a coverage-gap audit:
    - map which PE-local object transitions are visible only through `atlas_service / atlas_pod / atlas_census`
    - map which transitions are supposed to be visible in `atlas_activation_census` but currently are not
  - Do not chase performance here.
  - First complete the PE-internal object-plane visibility map, then decide whether to add missing stats or reinterpret existing runtime planes.
